chen gyi bden pa mngo na stodags yin pa gang zhig rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gi rgyud la mngon gyur tu 'byung ba de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rjes thob ye shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gsum pa ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam pa'i rgyud kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed dang / theg chen gyi mthong lam rjes thob ye shes la gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud kyi stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ dang por theg chen gyi mthong lam bzod pa brgyad po cig char du skye/ de'i rjes su theg chen gyi mthong lam shes pa brgyad po gcig char du skye/ de'i rjes su de gang rung ma yin pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam skye/ 'da' bya'i theg chen gyi mthong lam dang / 'da' byed kyi theg chen gyi mthong lam gnyis cig char du skye zhing / de gnyis masngoran gyur tu rim can du skye ba yin no/ /theg chen sgom lam gyi byed pa bshadapa/kun nas zhi dang thams cad la/ /zhes sku/gas kyi skabs su ྅7ra ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi cadam lam gyi byed pa chodas can/stu da la dbye na drug sku da de/ theg chen gyi khyodam lam balha ma rdo bas kyis thob pa'i sems la rang dbang byed pa sogs drug yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha 556

cig theg chen gyi khyodam lam bakhyodam rdo bas kyis cadab pa'i phan sku na de/ de'i mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams/ sa gnyis pa'i skad cig gnyis pa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod/ zer na/ byang sems sa dang po ba'i rgyud la theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi byed pa med par thal/ khyod kyi sa mtshams 'thad pa'i phyir/'dod na/ de yod par thal/ sa dang po'i sgom lam yod pa'i phyir te/ kun btus las byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sa bcu rnams su sgom pa'i lam la shes bya'i sgrib pa'i gnyen wa'i lam bsgom gyi zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi rgyur gyur ba'i rnam mkhyen chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ der thal/ rnam mkhyen yin pa'i phyir/'dod na/ de chos can/ theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi rjes su byung bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de'i snga logs su byung ba yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig rang thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i theg chen gyi khyodam lam bcadam lha bas kyis chodab pa'i rnam dkar gyi sku na tan de/ theg chen gyi 〉(ma lam gyi byed pa'i mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams lam ma zhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod/ zer na/ longs sku'i men mo zangs mdog chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtsho na bya de'i phyir/ ma grub na der thal/ theg chen gyi sbru/ma lam ༄/ma ༄/bas kyis thob pa'i phan yon yin pa'i phyir te/ snu sa can de'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ rnam dkar gyi yon tan 557

yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ dge ba yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ lung ma bstan yin pa'i phyir te/rnam smin gyi 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ mdzod las/ rnam smin lung du ma bstan chos/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / theg chen gyi lha/ma lam gyi phan sku na rgyud ldan gyi lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag sku da par thal/ de'i byed pa rgyud ldan gyi lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag gcig yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na / theg chen gyi rjodar ba'i phan mo na rgyud ldan gyi lam ma zhugs gyi gang zag gcig yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba thob pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag gcig sku da par thal/ 'awa da pa'i phyir/ byas pa la khe na re/ theg chen gyi lhu/ma lam gyi phan sku/na rgyud ldan gyi lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod par thal/ de'i byed las rgyud ldan gyi lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag mo da pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ ma grub na der thal/ ye shes chodas sku'i byed las rgyud ldan gyi lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir te/ de'i 'phrin las rgyud ldan gyi lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag sku da pa'i phyir te/ lam ma zhugs na ye shes chodas sku'i phrin las yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rang lugs la/ rang thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i theg chen gyi sgom lam bsgom stobs kyis thob pa'i phan yon de/ de'i byed pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na drug yod/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi sbru/ma lam basbru/ma pa'i skad cig gnyis pa nas sangs rgyas 558

kyi sa'i bar du yod/ gsum pa la kha cig theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi byed pa rgyud ldan gyi lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod par thal/ mtshan nyid de rgyud ldan gyi lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag sku da pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi sgom lam banywastom pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag sku(da pa'i phyir te/ rnam mkhyen ba〉/ma pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir te/ rnam mkhyen bsgom pa'i sems can yod pa'i phyir te/ 'grel ba las rnam pa dang lam dang gzhi rnam par bsgom pa'i rnam par dbye bas/ zhes bshad pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ lung de'i don ni / rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa banywa/ma pa'i sems can skusnad ces pa'i snga na yin pa'i phyir/ byas pa la yang kho na re/ rnam mkhyen bsgom pa'i sems can yod par thal/ sangs rgyas bsgom pa'i sems can sku/da pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ rnam mkhyen mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sems can yod par thal/ sangs rgyas mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sems can sku da pa'i phyir khyab pa so/nga / ma grub na/ der thal/ longs sku masgyu na sum du dodags pa'i sems can yod pa'i phyir te/ de macadan sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems 'phags pa sku da pa'i phyir te/ longs sku de byang sems 'phags pa yan chad kyi mngon sum gyi spyod yul yin pa'i phyir/rtsa bar 'dod na/ ye shes chos sku mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sems can yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ ye shes chos sku de sangs rgyas 'phags pa nang phan tshun 〈sna na'i mngon sum gyi khyodad yul yin pa'i phyir/559

byas pa la kho na re/ theg chen gyi sgom lam cor+shas can/ theg chen gyi ༄/ma lam gyi byed pa yin par thal/ rang thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i theg chen gyi sgom lam basbru/ma stobs kyis chodab pa'i phan yon yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi khyodam lam thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i theg chen gyi sgom lamayod pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyur gyur ba'i theg chen gyi sgom lam yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ yang kho na re/tshogs lam yin na/ cadam lam gyi byed pa min dathodas par thal/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud la theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi byed pa med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na / nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i theg chen gyi tshogs lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de yin par thal/ nyan thos kyi sgom lam gyi byed pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de bsgom stobs kyis thob pa'i phan sku(na yin pa'i phyir/ chodas can de yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/theg chen gyi sgom lam bshadapa/byed pa'i 'og du sgom pa'i lam ste/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang /mtha' dpyad pa gnyis las/ dang wa 3/ theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi byed pa bshad pa'i rjes su theg chen gyi 〉rtom lam 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan sku1da de/ theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi byed pa ston pa'i gzhung las/ theg chen gyi sgom lam ston 560

pa'i gzhung brjod bya mang ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar bshad pa yin pa'i phyir/de chos can/ khyod la dbye na gnyis yod de/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam dang theg chen gyi zag med 〈(ma lam gnyis su sku1da pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang 11 la kha cig khams spo/nga gi rten la/ theg chen gyi lha ma lam gsar du skye ba skusgod zer na/ khams thosneng gi rten can gyi byang sems mthong lam pa yod par thal lo/ /'dod mi nus te/ mdzod las/ gong na mjodzing lam med/ zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ kha cig theg chen gyi 〈snam lam gsar du skye ba'i sems rten la zag med sa dgur grangs nges zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ der gyur ba'i 'dod pa'i sems dang / srid rtse'i sems mostod pa'i phyir te/ 'grel chen las/ 'awa da pa'i khams dang gzugs kyi khams dang / gzugs med pa'i khams zhes snristos pas ni/ 'acadad pa la sku gas pa'i sa dgu'i sgom pa'i lam gzung bar bya'o/ /gang yang 'dod pa'i khams dang /srid rtse na byang chub lam gyi yan lag spangs zhes bya ba ni thabs la mi mkhas pa yin pa'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi dbang du byas pa yin gyis/ de dang 'di la 'gal ba med wosto/ /zhes bya ba ni kha cig thod/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rong ṭīka pa na re/ bdag med mngon sum du mthong zin sgom par byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ byang sems sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed 561

chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ mngon sum yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ rtog pa yin pa'i phyir te/ slob pa'i rgyud kyi kun rdzob sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/gzhan yang / mo sa pa ༄/ma lam chodas can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ masnuran bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ mngon sum yin par thal lo/ /'dod mi nus te/ stodag pa yin pa'i phyir te/ zag bcas lhu ma lam yin pa'i phyir/gzhan yang / cadad kyi mtshan nyid de mi 'thad par thal/ theg chen gyi cadam lam dang rtog pa'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir te/ yang dang yang du sems pa dang / /'jal dang nges rtog sgom pa'i lam/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ kha cig theg chen gyi mthong lam rdzogs rjes su byung zhing / theg chen gyi mi khyodab lam ma skyes thodang gi mkhyen pa de/ theg chen gyi cadam lam gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ theg chen gyi mjo nga lam gyi rgyur gyur ba'i theg chen gyi ༄/ma lam chodas can/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rdzogs rjes su byung bar thal/ theg chen gyi sgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de'i snga logs su byung ba yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / theg chen gyi mi cadab lam gyi 'bras bur gyur ba'i theg chen gyi khyodam lam snums can/ theg chen gyi mi khyodab lam ma skyes gong gi mkhyen pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de'i rjes su byung ba yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/562

kha cig theg chen gyi lhu/ma lam gang zhig mnyam bzhag ye shes su gyur ba de / theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig rjes thob ye shes su gyur ba de/ theg chen gyi zag bcas cadam lam gyi mtshan nyid zer na / gzugs bden stong sgyu ma lta bu gsal bar snang pa'i sa gnyis pa'i ye shes chos can/ mtshan nyid dang po'i zur phyi ma der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir te/sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bral ba'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon lha gas yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ tshig gsal las/ zag pa dang bcas pa dang zag pa med pa'i bye brag ni/ rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa dang / de dang bral ba gabo ra gyur bcad/ /zhes bshad pa de khas len pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ chos can de'i phyir/ kha cig sgom spang rtog pa'i dngos gnyen byed pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la masngaran sna gas de/ theg chen gyi cadam lam gyi mtshan nyid/ sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog par gyur ba'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sbru/ma lam gyi mtshan nyid/sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa ma yin par gyur ba'i theg chen gyi rjes la macan dodags de/ theg chen gyi zag med ༄/ma lam gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ sbru/ma spang rtog pa'i rgyur gyur ba'i theg chen gyi sgom lam yod par thal/ bden 'dzin gyi rgyur gyur ba'i theg chen gyi cadam lam sku da pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi cadam lam la dmigs nas bden 'dzin skyes pa yod pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dodad na/

sgom spang rtog pa'i rgyur gyur ba'i theg chen gyi sgom lam chos can/ sgom spang ho ga pa'i dasngo sa gnyen yin par thal/ theg chen gyi sbru/ma lam yin pa'i phyir/khyab pa song / 'dod na/ nge chos can/ de la gasnyad byed yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de la phan 'dogs byed yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / theg chen gyi 〈(ma lam cesas can/ theg chen gyi zag bcas cadam lam yin par thal/ sgra ro/na 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la masngoran ho gas yin pa'i phyir te/ de dang de ma yin par gyur ba'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs gang rung gang zhig phyi ma ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang sngo grub ste/ theg chen gyi cadam lam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ de snu sa can/ theg chen gyi zag med cadam lam yin par thal/ ma grub pa de'i phyir/ 'asnga da mi nus te/ theg chen gyi zag bcas cadam lam sdudad yin pa'i phyir/ mabar 'asnga da mi nus te/ theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam khyod yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i ho ga pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la macadan lto gas te/ zag bcas sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bral ba'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtog de/ zag med sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ nyan thodas sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi thar ba don gnyer gyi lho chos can/theg chen gyi rjes la masngogan sna gas yin par thal/ zag bcas lhu/ma lam yin 564

sgom spang rtog pa'i rgyur gyur ba'i theg chen gyi sgom lam chos can/ sgom spang ho ga pa'i dasngo sa gnyen yin par thal/ theg chen gyi sbru/ma lam yin pa'i phyir/khyab pa song / 'dod na/ nge chos can/ de la gasnyad byed yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de la phan 'dogs byed yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / theg chen gyi 〈(ma lam cesas can/ theg chen gyi zag bcas cadam lam yin par thal/ sgra ro/na 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la masngoran ho gas yin pa'i phyir te/ de dang de ma yin par gyur ba'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs gang rung gang zhig phyi ma ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang sngo grub ste/ theg chen gyi cadam lam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ de snu sa can/ theg chen gyi zag med cadam lam yin par thal/ ma grub pa de'i phyir/ 'asnga da mi nus te/ theg chen gyi zag bcas cadam lam sdudad yin pa'i phyir/ mabar 'asnga da mi nus te/ theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam khyod yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i ho ga pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la macadan lto gas te/ zag bcas sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bral ba'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtog de/ zag med sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ nyan thodas sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi thar ba don gnyer gyi lho chos can/theg chen gyi rjes la masngogan sna gas yin par thal/ zag bcas lhu/ma lam yin 564

pa'i phyir te/ sgra don 'dres ru nga du 'dzin pa'i rto ga pa dang bcas pa'i rjes la mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir te/ chodas can de'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te / theg dman gyi lhu/ma lam yin pa'i phyir/ mtshan nyid gnyis pa la/ nyan thos kyi khyodam lam bar chad med lam chodas can/ theg chen gyi rjes la macagan shodags yin par thal/ zag med lha ma lam yin pa'i phyir te/ sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bral ba'i rjes la mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir te /snu sa can de'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'asnga da mi nus te/ theg dman gyi cadam lam yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs la sgom lam gyi rtenadang brtenapa sgom lamabashadapa/gnyis pa rang lugs la/ theg chen gyi khyodam lam gyi rten bshad pa dang / brten pa theg chen gyi cadam lam bshad pa gnyis las/ dang sngo/ la/ lus rten bshad pa / sems rten bshad pa gnyis las/ dang wa 3/ gling gsum gyi mi dang 'dod lha rigs drug gi rten la theg chen gyi sgom lam gsar du skye ba yod de/de rnams kyi rten la de gsar du skye ba'i 'gal rkyen dang bral zhing mthun rkyen tshang ba yod pa'i phyir/ gzugs khams pa'i rten la theg chen gyi rākha lam gsar 565

du skye ba med de/ gzugs khams pa'i rten can gyi byang sems masngo nga lam pa med pa'i phyir/ skyes zin gnas pa'i dbang du byas na/ gzugs khams pa'i rten la theg chen gyi cadam lam skyes zin gnas pa sku da de/ de'i rten can gyi byang sems sgom lam pa yod pa'i phyir/ gzugs med khams pa'i rten la skyes zin gnas pa yang med de/ de'i rten can gyi byang sems 'phags pa med pa'i phyir te / mdo bsdud pa las/ byang chub yon tan brgya phrag nyams par 'gyur 'ongs zhes/ /gzugs med khams su skye ba don du gnyer mi byed/ /ces bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen gyi cadam lam gsar du skye ba'i sems rten la/khams gsum sa dgu yod de/ 'grel chen las 'dod pa'i khams dang / gzugs kyi khams dang / gzugs med pa'i khams zhes 1gas pa ni/ 'asnga da pa la sogs pa'i sa dgu'i sgom pa'i lam gzung bar bya'o/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa brten pa theg chen gyi sbrusam lam bshad pa la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi rjes la malnga na stodags/theg chen gyi lhu/ma lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam dang / theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam gnyis su yod/ sgra don 'dre sa rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bral ba'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ theg chen gyi zag 566

med lhu/ma lam gyi mtshan nyid/ gsum pa/ sa mtshams/ sa dang tu/ nas sa bcu pa'i bar du yod/zag bcasadang zag med sgom lam gyi mtshananyid la rtsod sgong / gsum pa la kho na re/ sa gnyis pa'i ye shes chodas can/ mcho na bya gnyis pa der thal/ sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la masngoran sna gas yin pa'i phyir te/ de sna ga pa dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de bden 'dzin dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ ma grub na der thal/ de shes sgrib dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'awa da mi nus te / sa gnyis pa'i bar chad med lam ༷ da yin pa'i phyir/ yang kho na re/ sa gnyis pa'i bar chad med lam de/ sgra 'don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bcas pa yin par thal/ de dodag pa dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de theg chen sems bskyed dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ ma grub na/ der thal/ sa gnyis pa'i bar chad med lam la gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud la theg chen sems bskyed yod pa'i phyir/ yang kho na re/ sa gnyis pa'i bar chad med lam de/ bden 'dzin gyi ho ga pa dang bcas pa yin par thal/ de bden 567

'dzin dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ rtog pa dang bcas pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ kho na re/ gzugs bden stong sgyu ma lta bur gsal bar snang ba'i sa gnyis pa'i ye shes de/ nyon mo ngas dang bcas pa yin par thal/ de bden 'dzin dang bcas pa gang zhigamatshungs pa'i phyir/ 'asnga da na/ de chodas can/ zag pa dang bcas pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la masngoran sna gas yin par thal/ zag pa dang bcas pa gang zhig theg chen gyi rjes la masngoran stodags yin pa'i phyir/ 'asnga da na/ de chos can/ theg chen gyi zag bcas lhu/ma lam yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ yang kho na re/ theg chen gyi ༄/ma lam cesas can/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam yin par thal/ sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la masngo na sna gas yin pa'i phyir te/ de dang bcas pa'i de dang / de dang bral ba'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs gang rung yin/phyi ma ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ theg chen gyi sgom lam yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtsa bar 'awa da mi nus te/ theg chen gyi zag med cadam lam khyod yin pa'i phyir/ yang kho na re/ sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa yin na / zag bcas yin dgos par thal lo/ /sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i the/ga pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la ma1ran the gas theg chen gyi zag bcas

sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ 'asnga/da na/ mos pa sgom lam chodas can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ zag med yin pa'i phyir te/lam bden yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ mdzod las/ zag med lam gyi bden pa dang / /zhes bshad pa'i phyir na yang ma khyab ste/ cad na/ lam bden las gzhan pa'i 'dus byas yin na/ zag bcas yin dbo sa par thal/ malhu/da las/ lam ma gtogs pa'i 'dus byas rnams/ zag bcas zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab pa sdudang / 'asnga da na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa chodas can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ yang kho na re/ zag bcas cadam lam yin na/ zag bcas yin dathodas par thal/ mo sa pa sgom lam zag bcas yin pa'i phyir/ 'awa da na / nyan thos dgra bathodam pa'i cadags pa khyodan du sdudang ba'i snu sa pa sgom lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ zag pa dang bcas par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod mi nus te/ de zag pa dang bral ba yin pa'i phyir te/ nyan chodas dgra bathe ma pa de/ zag pa dang bral ba yin pa'i phyir te/ de dgra bathodam pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ malnga las/ thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ yang kho na re/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i lto gas pa nyon du sku/nga ba'i snu sa pa sbru/ma lam chodas can/ zag bcas ma yin par thal/ zag pa dang bral ba yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ rtags grub ste/ dgra bathodam pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / rnam 569

bshad las/ 'di dag zag bcas su bzhag pa ni/ sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i shodag pa dang bcas pa la zag bcas su bzhag pa yin gyi/ spang byas bsdus pa'i zag bcas ni ma yin te/ zhes pa dang / kun btus las/ zag bcas la spang byas khyab par bshad pa shes byed du 'dren pa ni 'brel ba med de/ de ni pho/na snu/ngas pa'i zag bcas yin pas sku// /zhes bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/zag bcas 〈(ma lam yin na/ zag bcas yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / sa gnyis pa'i bar chad med lam de/ bden 'dzin dang bral ba yin par thal/ de bden 'dzin sna ga pa dang bcas pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ de chos can/ blo bur gyi dri ma dang bral bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/'dod mi nus te/ de rang gi gzigs pa'i ngo bor blo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba ltar snang yang / de dang ma bral ba'i brdzun pa bslu ba'i chos can yin pa'i phyir te / byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi bden med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ des na ྅/na mo1ngas pa'i zag bcas yin na/ spang bya yin pas khyab/ byas pa la kherdzo na re/ sa gnyis pa'i ye shes cesas can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ nyon mongs pa'i zag dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ ma grub na/ der thal/ thodan snu ngas dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ zer na/ zag bcas yin na spang bya yin dbostes par thal/zag bcas sbru1ma lam yin na/ zag bcas yin pas ma khyab pa la rgyu mtshan sku1da 570

pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nyan thos kyi spyor lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ nyan thodas khyodar lam pa de/ zag bcas yin pa'i phyir te / de sku skye yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'thodad mi nus te/ thar lam yin pa'i phyir/ yang kho na re/ zag pa dang bcas pa yin na/ sna ga pa dang bcas pas khyab par thal/ khyod kyi theg chen gyi zag bcas ༄/ma lam gyi mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod na/ nyon mongs 'kho ra du ldan pa'i mig gi rnam par shes pa chodas can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ thodan mo ngas dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de sku/da pa'i phyir te/ kun btus las/'dod chags ni 'dod pa'i khams na rnam par shes pa'i snumags drug dang mtshungs par ldan pa rig par bya'o/ /'dod chags ji lta ba bzhin du/ khong khro dang ma rig pa yang de bzhin du/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'asnga da mi nus te / stodag pa dang bral ba yin pa'i phyir te/ the ga med kyi shes pa yin pa'i phyir/yang khe na re/ skabs 'dir bstan pa'i zag pa dang bcas ma bcas kyi ro/na de / sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa yin min la byed rigs par thal/khyodad kyi mtshan nyid phyi ma gnyis 'thad pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'alha da na/ mo/sa pa cadam lam la gnas pa'i byang sems 'phags pa snu sa can/ sgra wa na 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa yin par thal/ skabs 'dir bstan pa'i sgra snga na 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bcas pa'i phyir te/ mos pa sgom lam dang bcas 571

pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nyan thos kyi spyor lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ nyan thodas khyodar lam pa de/ zag bcas yin pa'i phyir te / de sku skye yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'thodad mi nus te/ thar lam yin pa'i phyir/ yang kho na re/ zag pa dang bcas pa yin na/ sna ga pa dang bcas pas khyab par thal/ khyod kyi theg chen gyi zag bcas ༄/ma lam gyi mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod na/ nyon mongs 'kho ra du ldan pa'i mig gi rnam par shes pa chodas can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ thodan mo ngas dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de sku/da pa'i phyir te/ kun btus las/'dod chags ni 'dod pa'i khams na rnam par shes pa'i snumags drug dang mtshungs par ldan pa rig par bya'o/ /'dod chags ji lta ba bzhin du/ khong khro dang ma rig pa yang de bzhin du/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'asnga da mi nus te / stodag pa dang bral ba yin pa'i phyir te/ the ga med kyi shes pa yin pa'i phyir/yang khe na re/ skabs 'dir bstan pa'i zag pa dang bcas ma bcas kyi ro/na de / sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa yin min la byed rigs par thal/khyodad kyi mtshan nyid phyi ma gnyis 'thad pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'alha da na/ mo/sa pa cadam lam la gnas pa'i byang sems 'phags pa snu sa can/ sgra wa na 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa yin par thal/ skabs 'dir bstan pa'i sgra snga na 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bcas pa'i phyir te/ mos pa sgom lam dang bcas 571

pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ yang khe/ na re/ snu sa pa sbru/ma lam 6)sa can/ 97da dang bcas na/ skabs 'dir bstan pa'i sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bcas pas khyab par thal/ khyod skabs 'dir bstan pa'i sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa yin pa'i phyir na yang ma khyab/ yang kho na re/ khyod kyi mtshan nyid gnyis pa de mi 'thad par thal/ sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i sna ga pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam sku da pa'i phyir te/sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bcas pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi rnal 'byor mngon sum sku da pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de dang bcas pa'i byang sems 'phags pa chodas can/ stu da kyi rgyud kyi rnal 'drodar masngo na sum sku da par thal/ stu da byang sems 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir na/ chos can skyodan can yin theṭa/ /lnga sa pa lha ma lam bshad pa/mos pa rang gi don dang ni/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mo sa pa sbru/ma lam chodas can/ ༷ da la dbye na / nyi shu rtsa bdun sku da de/ rang thodan mo sa pa khyodam lam dgu/ gzhan snga na mo sa pa cadam lam dgu/ gnyis snga na mo/sa pa sbru/ma lam dgu rnams su sku/da pa'i 572

phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po la kha cig yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i zag pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de/ mos pa sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ rang don mos pa sgom lam dang /gzhan don mos pa sgom lam gnyis 'gal zer na/ 'o na/ yum rang sngo na gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs dang / yum gzhan wa na gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la macadan dodags gnyis 'gal bar thal/ khyod kyi dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs chos can/ yum rang don gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs ma yin par thal/ yum gzhan don gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la masngo na the gas yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ der thal/ yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon ho gas yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig yum don gsum po gang rung gi 'byungaganas su yid ches pa'i zag pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la masngo na lto gas de/ mo sa pa sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ zer na/ nyan lnga sa dgra bcom pa'i sna gas pa ༄/na du song ba'i snugs pa sbrusam lam chodas can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya 573

de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ zag pa dang bral ba yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can de'i phyir/ gnyis pa rang gi lugs la/ yum don gsum po gang rung gi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la macadan the gas de/ ce/sa pa sbru/ma lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la rtsa ba'i cad nas dbye na gsum/ yan lag gi cad nas dbye na dgu/nying lag gi cad nas dbye na nyi shu rtsa bdun sku da/ sa mtshams sa dang sngo/ nas sa bcu ba'i bar na mo da/ gsum pa la kho na re/ theg dman gyi mo sa pa cadam lam med par thal/ khyod kyi mtshan nyid 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de yod par thal/ theg dman gyi mo sa pas bsdus pa'i lha ma lam sku/da pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'asnga da na/ theg dman gyi gzhan snga na mo sa pa cadam lam sku da par thal/ theg dman gyi mo sa pa khyodam lam yod pa'i phyir/ 'asnga da na/ gzhan ro/na gtso bor don du gnyer ba'i theg dman gyi sgom lam yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ma khyab mtshams la/ theg dman gyi sgrub pa sbru/ma lam sku/da par thal/ theg dman gyi sgrub pas bsdus pa'i lha ma lam sku da pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ byas pa la kho na re/ theg dman gyi mo sa pa nywa ma lam sku da par thal/ theg dman gyi zag bcas cadam lam sku/da pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ theg dman gyi rnam dag khyodam lam mo da par thal/ theg dman gyi zag med khyodam lam sku da pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ 'dod na/ bden 'dzin rnam par dag byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i 574

theg dman gyi sgom lam yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'alha/da na/ shes sgrib rnam par dag byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i theg dman gyi khyodam lam sku da par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ yang kho na re/ yum don gsum po gang rung gi 'byung gnas yin par thal/ khyod kyi mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'awa da na/ yum don gsum po gang rung gi rgyu yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod na / don gsum po gang rung gi rgyu yod par thal lo/ /'dod mi nus te/ don gsum po gang rung rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab mtshams la/ shes bya chodas can/ rang gi cha shas la ltos nas skye bar thal/ rang gi cha shas la khyodas nas 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ der thal/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'asnga da na/ de chos can/ rang gi cha shas kyi 'bras bu yin par thal/ 'dodad pa'i phyir/ byas pa la kho na re/rang snga/na mos pa khyodam lam dang / gzhan snga na mo sa pa khyodam lam gnyis 'gal bar thal/ yum gatho rwanar rang don gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i rjes la mngon rtogs dang / yum gathob dur gzhan dodan gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i rjes la mngon rtogs gnyis 'gal ba yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ codi na/ yum gatho rwakur rang don gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i byang sems kyi sgom lam gcig yod par thal/ khyod kyi thal 'gyur de la khyab 'brel cig sku/da pa'i phyir/'dod na/ rang don gtso bor don du gnyer ba'i byang sems sgom lam pa yod 575

par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ byas pa la kho na re/ rang don mos pa sgom lam dang / gzhan thodan mo sa pa lhu/ma lam gnyis 'gal bar thal/ rang wa na chos sku dang gzhan dodan gzugs sku gnyis 'gal ba'i phyir na ma khyab/mos pa sgom lam gyi phanasku/na bshad pa/shes rab pha snga la phyin pa la/ /zhes sku/gas kyi skabs su rjodar ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ snu/sa pa nywa ma lam gyi phan sku na chodas can/khyod la dbye na nyi shu rtsabadun yod de/ bstod pa dgu/ bkur ba dgu/ bsngags pa dgu rnams su sku da pa'i phyir/ byas pa la kho na re/ mo sa pa lha ma lam gyi phan sku/na rgyud ldan kyi lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag sku/da par thal/ mo sa pa ༄/ma lam bcadam lha/bas kyis chodab pa'i phan sku na rgyud ldan gyi lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir zer na/ 'di'i lan 'og tu 'chad/bathob sgom lamabashadapa/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ byang sems sa gnyis pa ba'i rgyud kyi bsngo 576

ba chodas can/ nyan rang gi bsngo ba las khyad par du 'phags pa phyir te/ rang gzhan gyi dge rtsardzogs byang gi yan lag tu bsgyur ba'i bsngo ba yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la gsum las dang sngo la/ kha cig rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa snyungags byang gi rgyur bsgyur ba'i zag pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la macadan shodags/bsngo ba sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ snyu gas byang gi rgyu sku da par thal/ khyod kyi dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ rdzogs byang rtag pa yin pa'i phyir te/ ngo bo nyid sku de rdzogs pa'i byang chub yin pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa the gas byang gi yan lag tu bsgyur ba'i zag pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mthoran lha gas/ ba1/ ba ༄/ma lam gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i bsngo ba sgom lam chos can/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la masngoran skadags yin par thal/ bakhyod ba sgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'asnga da mi nus te/ zag pa dang bral ba'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs la/ rang gzhan gang rung gi dge rtsa rdzogs byang gi yan lag tu bsgyur ba'i sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la masnga na stodags/ bakhyod ba cadam lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na bcu gnyis sku/da/ sa mtshams sa/ dang sngo nas sa bcu'i bar du yod/ gsum pa rtsod pa cadang ba la kho na re/ rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa rdzogs byang gi yan lag tu bsgyur ba'i theg chen gyi sbru/ma lam sku da par 577

thal/ khyod kyi mtshan nyid 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de kho kho rang yin par thal/ kho yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa rdzogs byang gi yan lag yin par thal/ 'asnga da pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dodad na/ dge rtsa yin na cadags byang gi yan lag yin dathodas par thal/ 'dodad pa'i phyir/ 'awa da mi nus te/ rtsodags byang du ma bsngos pa'i dge rtsa mo da pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang /nyan sngo sa sgos lam pa'i dge rtsartsodags byang gi yan lag tu bsgyur ba'i byang sems kyi cadam lam mo da par thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'aro/da mi nus te/nyan lnga sa ༄/ma lam pa dang / byang sems sbru/ma lam pa gnyis rgyud tha dad yin pa'i phyir/ zer zhing / kho rang gi lugs la/ rang rgyud kyi dge rtsa rdzogs byang gi yan lag du bsgyur ba'i theg chen gyi rjes la macadan rtogs bakhyod ba cadam lam gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ byang sems sa gnyis pa'i rgyud kyi ba14 ba ༄/ma lam chodas can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mchodan bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i rgyud kyi dge rtsa rdzogs byang gi yan lag yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na / de'i rgyud kyi dge rtsa yin na rtsodags byang gi yan lag yin dbo sa par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i rgyud kyi gzhung sher phyin chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ khyab pa rnams rim pa bzhin lha/nga / ma grub na der thal/de'i rgyud kyi rnam dkar gyi sku na tan yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'asnga da na/ de chodas can/ byang chub kyi yan lag yin par thal/ 'dodad pa'i phyir/ 'awa da mi 578

nus te/ rjod byed kyi tshig yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / nyan thos sgom lam pas zas phul ba'i dge rtsa rdzogs byang gi yan lag tu bsngos pa'i byang sems sa gnyis pa'i rgyud kyi bsngo ba chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ masnumin bya de'i phyir/rjes suyi rang sgom lam bshad pa/thabs dang mi dmigs pa dag gi/ /zhes sku/gas kyi skabs su ྅mor ba dang /mtha' dpyad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ byang sems sa gnyis pa'i rgyud kyi rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa la dga' ba bsgom pa'i ye shes chos can/ rjes su yid rangs sgom lam yin te/ rang gzhan gyi dger rtsa la dga' ba bsgom pa'i sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon sna gas yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha cig rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa la dga' ba bsgom pa'i zag pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la masngo na sna gas/ rjes su yi rangs sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ rang gi dge rtsal dga' ba bsgom pa'i rjes su yi rangs cadam lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ masnuran bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ ga zhan gyi dge rtsa la dga' ba bsgom pa'i zag pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la masngo na rtogs yin par thal/579

'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rang gi dge rtsa gzhan gyi dge rtsa yin par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ kha cig rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa la dga' ba bsgom pa'i rab tu phye ba'i theg chen gyi rjes la masngoran ༷ gas de/ de'i mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi ༄/ma lam yin na/ snu/sa pa sbru/ma lam dang / bsngo ba sbru/ma lam/ rjes su yi rangs lhu/ma lam gsum ka yin pas khyab zer na/ gang zag gi bdag med wa na spyi'i tshul gyis lto gas pa'i theg chen gyi khyodam lam chodas can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ rjes su yi rangs lhu ma lam yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi zag bcas lha ma lam yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ rtsa bar 'asnga da na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi yul du gyur ba'i dge rtsa yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/'dod na/ gang zag gi bdag med dge rtsa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/'dod na/ de chos can/ 'dus byas yin par thal/ 'asnga da pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / snu sa baljo res su yi rangs cadam lam gsum la byed las mi 'dra ba'i khyad par med par thal/ de gsum yin khyab mnyam yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sbru/ma lam yin na/ de gsum ka yin dbonas pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ rang lugs la/ rang gzhan gang rung gi dge rtsa la dga' ba cadam pa'i sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon skadags/ rjes su yi rangs sbru/ma lam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na gnyis sku da/ sa mtshams sa dang sngo nas sa bcu'i bar na sku da/ ce da pa blo nga ba la 580

'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rang gi dge rtsa gzhan gyi dge rtsa yin par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ kha cig rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa la dga' ba bsgom pa'i rab tu phye ba'i theg chen gyi rjes la masngoran ༷ gas de/ de'i mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi ༄/ma lam yin na/ snu/sa pa sbru/ma lam dang / bsngo ba sbru/ma lam/ rjes su yi rangs lhu/ma lam gsum ka yin pas khyab zer na/ gang zag gi bdag med wa na spyi'i tshul gyis lto gas pa'i theg chen gyi khyodam lam chodas can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ rjes su yi rangs lhu ma lam yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi zag bcas lha ma lam yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ rtsa bar 'asnga da na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi yul du gyur ba'i dge rtsa yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/'dod na/ gang zag gi bdag med dge rtsa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/'dod na/ de chos can/ 'dus byas yin par thal/ 'asnga da pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / snu sa baljo res su yi rangs cadam lam gsum la byed las mi 'dra ba'i khyad par med par thal/ de gsum yin khyab mnyam yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sbru/ma lam yin na/ de gsum ka yin dbonas pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ rang lugs la/ rang gzhan gang rung gi dge rtsa la dga' ba cadam pa'i sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon skadags/ rjes su yi rangs sbru/ma lam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na gnyis sku da/ sa mtshams sa dang sngo nas sa bcu'i bar na sku da/ ce da pa blo nga ba la 580

kho na re/ bsam gtan gsum pa'i rten can gyi byang sems ༄/ma lam pa'i rgyud kyi rjes su yi rangs sgom lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mchodan bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ dga' ba dang bcas pa yin par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ dga' ba la 'dod chags dang bral ba yin pa'i phyir te/ chodas can de yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/sgrub pa sgom lam bshad pa/zag pa dang bcas pa'i 'og tu/ zag pa med pa'i sgom pa'i lam ste/ zhes pa'i skabs su sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi zag med ༄ ma lam chodas can/ sdudad la dbye na gnyis sku da de/ sgrub pa lha ma lam dang rnam dag sgom lam gnyis sku/da pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig theg chen gyi zag med ༄/ma lam gang zhig bar chad med lam gyi ngo bor gyur ba de/ sgrub pa sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig rnam bo la lam gyi sngarwa nar 'gyur ba de/ rnam dag cadam lam gyi mtshan nyid/ zer na/ theg chen gyi zag med cadam lam chodas can/ sgrub pa sbru/ma lam yin par thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chodas can/ rnam bo la lam gyi cas ngar gyur ba yin par thal/ rnam dag khyodam lam yin pa'i phyir/ ma 581

grub na/ der thal/ theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam gang zhig sgrub pa sgom lam ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtags phyi ma dngos/ kha cig theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam gang zhig rtogs pa mthar thug gi rgyur gyur ba de/ sgrub pa khyodam lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig spangs pa mthar thug gi rgyur gyur ba de/ rnam dag sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ rtogs pa mthar thug gi rjes su byung ba'i sgrub pa sgom lam chos can/ rtogs pa mthar thug gi rgyu yin par thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i snga logs su byung bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de'i rjes su byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / spangs pa mthar thug gi rgyu yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig theg chen gyi sgom lam gang zhig rtogs pa mthar thug gi lag rjes 'jog byed de/ sgrub pa sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig spangs pa mthar thug gi lag rjes 'jog byed de/ rnam dag sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ rtogs pa mthar thug gyi rjes su byung ba'i sgrub pa sgom lam chos can/ rtogs pa mthar thug gyi lag rjes 'jog byed yin par thal lo/ /'dod na/ de'i snga logs su byung bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de'i rjes su byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rang lugs la/ zag med kyi theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs gang zhig rang gi thob byar gyur ba'i rtogs pa mthar thug gyi lag rjes 'jog 582

byed de/ sgrub pa sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig rang gi thob byar gyur ba'i spangs pa mthar thug gyi lag rjes 'jog byed de/ rnam dag sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de gnyis don gcig pa yin pa'i phyir te/ gser phreng las/ mnyam bzhag zag med gcig nyid kyi yul sna gas tshul gyi cad nas jo ba bya 'grub par byed pa dang / spang bya 'joms tshul gyi sgo nas dri ma sel bar byed pa gnyis kyi ldog ba nas bstan pas 'di gnyis ngo rwasga tha dad par mi bsam mo / / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ byas pa la kho na re/ de gnyis ro/na gcig ma yin par thal/ sgrub pa 〈(ma lam yin na/ rjes 11ba ye shes yin dgos/ rnam dag sbru/ma lam yin na/ mnyam gzhag ye shes yin dbenas pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ rnam pa kun gyi mchodag ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas sku ni des thodab pa/ /de ni rjes las thob pa yi/ /ye shes 'bras bu yin par lha na//zhes pa dang / mdze sde rgyan las/ thub pas gsungs pa'i dam chodas legs bzhag pa/ rtsa ba chos kyi dbyings la lho thodas bzhag /dran rgyu sna ga pa tsam rig brtan pa dag /myur du yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha mo la 'bo / /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ chu ma〉rga sogs bzhin 'aro/da chags sku gas/ /blo bur nyon mongs dag pa ni/ /maro/ra na mi dodag ye shes kyi / / las gyi 'bras bur rab tu brjod/ /ces dang / mdo sde rgyan las/blo dang ldan pa'i mi rtog ye shes stodabs/ /rtag tu kun nas mnyam par sku nga ba

yis/ /de la brten pa'i nyes tshogs tshang tshing dag /dug sman chen pos dug bzhin sel bar byed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ lung de rnams kyi don ni/ rjes thob kyi sgrub pa sgom lam de/ rtogs pa mthar thug gi lag rjes 'jog byed dang / mnyam gzhag gi rnam dag sgom lam de/ spangs pa mthar thug gi lag rjes 'jog byed yin zhes pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ yang kho na re/ sgrub pa sgom lam dang / rnam dag lhurtom lam gnyis 'gal ba yin par thal/ gtso bor spangs pa mthar thug thob byed kyi rtogs rigs dang / gtso lha/ra rtogs pa mthar thug thob byed kyi rtogs rigs gnyis 'gal ba'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ dang po de yin na/ shes bya ji lta ba la dmigs pa'i ye shes yin dgos pa gang zhig gnyis pa yin na/ shes bya ji snyed pa la dmigs pa'i ye shes yin dathodas pa'i phyir zer na/ sa gnyis pa'i bar chad med lam chos can/ gathorwa 1ra rtogs pa mthar thug thob byed kyi rtogs rigs ma yin par thal/ gathorwa 1ra spangs pa mthar thug thob byed kyi rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa sku nga / ma grub na/ der thal/ gatho rwanar mi gnas pa'i myang 'das thob byed kyi ho gas rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ cangabar 'dod mi nus te/ gathorwa 1ra thams cad mkhyen pa thob byed kyi rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/ de yi ngo bo nyid mchog nyid/ /ces sogs kyi skabs su sbyor ba 'god 584

pa ni/ sgrub pa sgom lam chos can/ khyad par lnga dang ldan pa yin te/ ngo bo'i khyad par/ 'bras bu'i khyad par/ byed las kyi khyad par/ gnas skabs kyi sku na tan dang 'brel ba'i khyad par/ mthar thug gyi yon tan dang 'brel ba'i khyad par te/ khyad par lnga dang ldan pa'i phyir/rnamadag sgom lam bshad pa/'bras bu dag pa gzugs la lha/gas/ /zhes lha/gas kyi skabs su kha cig 'bras bu rnam grol lam chodas can/ khyodad dri mas dag pa na/ khyodad kyi yul gzugs sku gas kyang dri mas dag pa yin te/ stu da dri mas dag pa'i dag pa dang / khyodad kyi yul gzugs sku gas dri mas dag pa'i dag pa gnyis/ rang mtshan la rdzas tha dad ma yin zhing / spyi mtshan la ldog pa so sor bcad du med pa'i phyir/ zer na / rnam mkhyen dri mas dag pa na/ rnam mkhyen gyi yul gzugs lha/gas/ dri mas dag par thal/ khyodad kyi khyodar ba 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'awa da na/ rnam mkhyen dri mas dag pa na/ rnam mkhyen gyi yul sku sku skye bo yang dri mas dag par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sems can 'bad med lhun grub tu grol bar thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ rong ṭīka pa na re/ 'bras bu rnam grol lam chos can/ khyod rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi dri mas dag pa na/ khyod kyi yul 585

gzugs sogs kyang / rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi thogs skal gyi dri mas dag pa yin te/ khyod de'i dri mas dag pa'i dag pa dang / khyod kyi yul gzugs sogs des dag pa'i dag pa gnyis/ ngo ku tha dad ma yin zhing ldog pa so sor bcad du med pa'i phyir/ zer na/ rnam mkhyen rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu'i bar chad med lam gyi sngo sa skal gyi dri mas dag pa na/ rnam mkhyen gyi yul gzugs sku/gas kyang / de'i ngos skal gyi dri mas dag par thal/ khyod kyi sbyor ba 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'artsodad na/ rnam mkhyen de'i cadas skal gyi dri mas dag pa na/ rnam mkhyen gyi yul so so skye bo yang de'i ngos skal gyi dri mas dag par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'asnga da na/ rnam mkhyen shes sgrib kyis dag pa na/ de yang shes sgrib kyis dag par thal/ 'aro/da pa'i phyir/ 'dod na sla/ gzhan yang / rnam mkhyen rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu'i bar chad med lam gyi 1ras skal gyi dri mas dag pa'i dag pa dang / rnam mkhyen gyi yul gzugs sku gas de'i sngo sa skal gyi dri mas dag pa'i dag pa gnyis chos can/ khyod sdog pa so sor du yod par thal/ khyod shodag pa so sku ba yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de gnyis shodag pa tha dad yin pa'i phyir te/ de gnyis ka yod pa'i phyir/ rtags khyodad rang gi lugs la da3ris/ mkhas pa kha cig sa gnyis pa'i rnam bo/la lam 〉〉sa can/ khyod rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi dri mas dag pa na/ khyodad rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi gzugs snu gas kyang rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngo sa 586

skal gyi dri mas dag pa yin te/ khyod rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi dri mas dag pa'i dag pa dang / khyod rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi gzugs sogs rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi cadas skal gyi dri mas dag pa gnyis wa de dag bya gcig gis dben pa'i dag pa rigs mtshungs yin pa'i phyir/ zer na/'bras bu dag pa gzugs la 1/gas/ /zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i gzugs de gang zag gi rgyud kyi gzugs kho na la byed rigs par thal/ khyod kyi sbyor ba 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'bras bu rnam par dag pa gang yin pa de ni gzugs rnam par dag pacad/ /zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i gzugs de yang gang zag gi rgyud kyi gzugs kho na la byed rigs par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/'dod na/ phyi'i stod kyi 'jig rten de/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chodas rnams kyi nang du mi 'du bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / rnam grol lam yin na/ rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi cadas skal gyi dri mas dag pas khyab par thal/ khyod kyi sbyor ba 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nyan thos kyi sgom lam rnam grol lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de snu sa can/ rang rgyu rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam gyi sngoras skal gyi dri mas dag par thal/ khyod kyi rgyur gyur ba'i rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam sku da pa gang zhig ༷rmed rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngo sa skal gyi dri mas dag pa'i dag pa yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ de'i rgyur gyur ba'i rnam mkhyen yod pa'i 587

phyir/ gnyis pa rang lugs la/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ khyod rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi dri mas dag pa na/ khyod kyi yul gzugs sku gas kyang khyod rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi dri mas dag pa yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod de'i dri mas dag pa'i dag pa dang / khyod kyi yul gzugs sogs de'i dri mas dag pa'i dag pa gnyis po de/ ngo ༷pre tha dad ma yin zhing / rigs gcig yin pa'i phyir/ rtsod pa spong ba la kho na re/ rnam mkhyen rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi dri ma med par thal/ khyod kyi sbyor ba 'thad pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod na / rnam mkhyen rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de sangs rgyas 'phags pa yin par thal/'asnga/da pa'i phyir/ de chodas can/ khyod yin na sangs rgyas 'phags pa yin pas khyab par thal/ ༷/da yin na sku/da pas khyab pa gang zhig na ltu/da sangs rgyas 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'asnga da na/ gang zag chodas can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ yang kho na re/ rnam mkhyen rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi dri mas dag pa de/ gro bur rnam dag yin par thal/ khyod kyi sbyor ba 'thad pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi dri ma spang bya yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ kha cig rnam grol lam yin na/ rang gi ngos skal gyi dri ma spangs pas khyab zer na/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rnam mkhyen gyi ngos skal gyi dri ma yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ ༈ pho na mo ngas shes bya lam gsum gyi/ /zhes sku gas kyi skabs

su / sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nyan bos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden chos can/ nyan cadas kyi rnam dag yin te/ nyon sgrib spangs pa'i nyan thos kyi bral ba yin pa'i phyir/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden chos can/ rang rgyal gyi rnam dag yin te/ gzugs phyi rol don 'dzin gyi rtog pa spangs pa'i rang rgyal gyi bral ba yin pa'i phyir/ byang sems sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden chos can/ byang sems kyi rnam dag yin te/ mthong spang spangs pa'i byang sems kyi bral ba yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden cor+shas can/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag shin tu ba yin te/ sgrib gnyis spangs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bral ba yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la kha cig nyon sgrib spangs pa'i nyan chodas kyi bral ba de/ nyan chodas kyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ gzugs phyi rol don 'dzin gyi rtog pa spangs pa'i rang rgyal gyi bral ba de/ rang rgyal gyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ lam gsum gyi sgrib pa ci rigs pa spangs pa'i byang sems kyi bral ba de/ byang sems kyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid zer na/ theg chen gyi rnam da ga yin na/ theg chen gyi myang 'das yin dbo sa par thal/ theg dman gyi rnam dag yin na/ theg dman gyi myang 'das yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ nyan lnga/sa kyi rnam dag yin na/ nyan thos kyi myang 'das yin dbo sa/ rang rgyal gyi rnam dag yin na/ rang rgyal gyi myang 'das yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis ka grub ste/ khyod kyi mtshan

nyid dang po gnyis ka 'thad pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ byang sems sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden chodas can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/der thal/ byang sems kyi rnam dag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/mi gnas pa'i myang 'das yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'aro/da na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi 'bo ga bden yin par thal/ 'asnga da pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / byang sems lhu/ma lam pa'i rgyud kyi 'bo/ga bden chos can/ mtshan nyid phyi ma der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lam gsum gyi sgrib pa ci rigs pa rgyud la ldan pa'i byang sems sgom lam pa cig med par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ thodan sgrib spangs pa'i byang sems cadam lam pa yod pa'i phyir/ rong ṭīka pa na re/ nyon sgrib ma lus par spangs pa'i nyan thos kyi rnam bo/la lam de nyan chodas kyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ gzung ba chod sa kyi bdag 'dzin spangs pa'i rang rgyal gyi rnam grol lam/ rang rgyal gyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ shes sgrib spangs pa'i theg chen gyi rnam spo/la lam/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid zer na/ theg chen gyi rnam dag yin na/ shes sgrib spangs pa'i rnam bo la lam yin dathodas par thal/ theg dman gyi rnam dag yin na/ pho na sgrib spangs pa'i rnam bo la lam yin dbo sa pa'i phyir/ ma grub na / der thal/ nyan thos kyi rnam dag yin na yang de ltar yin dgos/ rang rgyal gyi rnam dag yin na de ltar yin dathodas pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis ka grub 590

ste / khyod kyi mtshan nyid dang po gnyis 'thad pa'i phyir/ rtsabar 'dod na/ byang sems sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ma grub na der thal/ byang sems kyi rnam dag yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang /sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi 'bo ga bden cesas can/ mtshan nyid phyi ma der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ ma grub na de choges can/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rnam dag yin par thal/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi blo bur rnam dag yin pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi 'thodag bden yin pa'i phyir/ byas pa la kho na re/ byang sems kyi rnam dag dang / shes pa'i gzhi mthun med par thal/ byang sems kyi rnam dag dang / rnam bo/la lam gyi gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir/ 'asnga da mi nus te/ byang sems kyi rnam dag khyodam lam sku da pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ 'dod na/ rnam dag sbru/ma lam yin na/ rnam dag yin dbo sa par thal/ khyodad kyi ma khyab mtshams la khyab 'brel cig sku da pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sgrub pa sgom lam yin na/ sgrub pa yin dgos par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sa gnyis pa'i bar chad med lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ dgag pa yin pa'i phyir/des na rnam dag yin na 'bo ga bden yin pas khyab/ byas pa la kho na re/ bum pa'i chodas nyid chodas can/ 'bo ga bden yin par thal/ rnam dag yin pa'i phyir te/ rang bzhin rnam dag yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'o na/ bum pa'i 591

chos nyid chos can/ myang 'das yin par thal/ rang bzhin gyi myang 'das yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ der thal/ chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / lta ba rnam dag yin na/ rnam dag yin dgos par thal/rang bzhin rnam dag yin na/ rnam dag yin dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi rnam dag rgyud ldan gyi lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod par thal theg chen gyi lta ba rnam dag rgyud ldan gyi lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir te/stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba rgyud ldan gyi lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir te / stong nyid rtogs pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rang lugs la/ rang thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi sgrib pa spangs pa'i nyan thos kyi bral ba de/ nyan thos kyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ de dang nyan thos kyi 'gog bden don gcig rang thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi sgrib pa spangs pa'i rang rgyal gyi bral ba de/ rang rgyal gyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ de dang rang rgyal gyi 'gog bden gnyis don gcig rang thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi sgrib pa spangs pa'i byang sems kyi bral ba de/ byang sems kyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ de dang byang sems kyi 'gog bden gnyis don gcig sgrib gnyis ma lus par spangs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bral ba de/sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ de dang sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud 592

kyi 'gog bden gnyis don gcig sa dgu la ni chen po yi/ /zhes sku/gas kyi skabs su sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag shin tu ba dang / nyan rang gi rnam dag shin tu ba ma yin pa'i khyad par 'thad pa yin te/ theg chen gyi sgom lam bar chad med lam chen wa'i chen po sogs dgu wa de/ rang gi ngos skal gyi spang byar gyur ba'i sgrib gnyis kyi dngos gnyen bar chad med lam gang zhig nyan thos kyi sbru/ma lam bar chad re/da lam chen gro'i chen po dgu po de/ rang gi ngos skal gyi spang byar gyur ba'i sgrib gnyis kyi dngos gnyen bar chad med lam ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha cig sa gnyis pa'i lha ma lam bar chad med lam de/ bden 'dzin chen wa'i chen po'i dngos gnyen bar chad med lam yin pa nas sa bcu pa'i bar chad med lam de/ bden 'dzin chung ngu'i chung ngu'i dngos gnyen bar chad med lam yin ho ཿra na/ rang gi ngos skal gyi spang byar gyur ba'i bden 'dzin chen po'i chen po'i dngos gnyen bar chad med lam yin na/ bden 'dzin chen po'i chen gro'i dngos gnyen yin dathodas par thal/ khyodad kyi dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sa dang po'i sgom lam bar chad med lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ rtags gsal gnyis ka grub ste/ chodas can de yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang sa bcu pa'i ye shes yin na rgyun mtha'i ye shes yin dgos par thal/ sa bcu ba'i bar chad med lam yin na/ rgyun mtha'i 593

bar chad med lam yin dgos pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ sa bcu ba'i bar chad med lam de/ rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ de bden 'dzin chung ngu'i chung ngu'i dngos gnyen bar chad med lam yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/par byang smonatshig lha rnam grol zhi ba'i rgya mtshor 1ri gcig tu/ /ga3/la ba'i mtha' yas 6)sa tshul dal 'bab klung / /tshig gi gzigs ma res kyang dug gsum gyi/ /dri ma yongs 'khrud legs bshad bdud cinga'adi/ /dpar du bskrun pa'i rnam dkar phung bo'i mthus/ /yang dag chos kyi khyod mo stodang phrag brgya/ /gdangs te rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /nges legs nor bu'i mdzod la dbang 'byor shog /ces 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon la 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam ston rnam 'dren shākya seṅge'i ring lugs sbru/ kun nas rgyas pa sku/gas 'phral yul legs snutogs du ma'i ched du dmigs/ nang bstan grub mtha' ris med kyi gsung rab dag dpar du bskrun dang bskrun 'gyur gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i dge bsngo'i blo na tshig tu shākya'i dge khyodang chodas smra ba ngag dbang sdud bzang bstan 'dzin rgya masnuras sbyar bcad// //sarba maṅga waṃ//dga' byang mdzub gcadan spyodag pu'i dpe sgrig sde tshan gyis phyi lo 2000 zla 5 tshes 15 nyin sngo da phreng bcu gcig pa zhu bsgrigs zhus//

༈ོna ma dkaro 'di yis mtha' klas zhing kun gyi / /snad btsod 'byar ba phul du byung ba dang / /bga' drin zhing mchog bzhi yi dri lan 'khor/ /ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar nam yang mi ltung zhing / /'di la thos sogs bgyid pa'i 'brel thogs kun/ /byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsigashesargyud brlan/ / 'di snang 'gags tshe dag pa'i zhing bzang du/ /brdzus te skyes nas don gnyisamathar phyin shag /ces pa 'di yang par skrun gyi byabazhaga'adir 'gro gron gtong mkhan dang / legayobashad 'di nyid 'dzin 'chang klog pa sogs kyi dge bsngo'i smon tshig tu bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lam̐/ /e+o nam amitābhās/: spar 'grem dang mthun 'gyur sbyor mkhan /gā'i wan nang pa'i shes yon bde 〈lhan tshogs/phyag deb 'di bzhin rin med du 'grem spel byed pa las tshong bsgyur byed mi chogaspar skrun byed yul thā'i wan /
dbe deb 'di rin med ngang 'grem 'a bul byed pa las comang bsgyur byed mi chogatshuno nam amitak+taya/kha'ikha)phyag dpe 'di chos sbyin du 'bul rgyu las/tshong bsgyur mi chog pa dgongs 'jags zhu/
